gameplay.finance_boundary: Rent bands and contract terms are references only; rent postings, balances and accounting remain BP-34.
gameplay.occupancy: Business occupancy is explicit; residential units remain unallocated until the separate population-allocation process.
gameplay.ownership: Chronological acquisition and transfer events resolve to the current property ownership interest.
gameplay.population: No person records, residents, tenants-as-persons, employees or police personnel are created.
gameplay.tenancy: Each registered business establishment has a current lease, licence or operating concession linked to its unit and landlord. A non-owner landlord resolves through a property-scoped authority granted by the current title holder. Agreement history is append-only; execution dates remain explicitly unrecorded unless evidenced.
gameplay.time: Historical years describe fictional backstory; current agreement and occupancy states begin at simulation tick zero.
